title: OpenStax Prealgebra 2e, 5.6 Ratios and Rate: Write a ratio as a fraction
summary: OpenStax Prealgebra 2e, 5.6 Ratios and Rate: Write a ratio as a fraction
body: OpenStax Prealgebra 2e, section "5.6 Ratios and Rate", prints these objectives: "Write a ratio as a fraction" "Write a rate as a fraction" "Find unit rates" "Find unit price" "Translate phrases to expressions with fractions". The section text says: "When you apply for a mortgage, the loan officer will compare your total debt to your total income to decide if you qualify for the loan. This comparison is called the debt-to-income ratio. A ratio compares two quantities that are measured with the same unit. If we compare a and b , the ratio is written as a to b , a b , or a : b ." This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
